label: Albedo
definition: A Radiation Reflectivity that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the capacity of its surface to reflect incident electromagnetic radiation of a particular wavelength.

label: Altitude
definition: A Height that inheres in a Site that externally connects an Independent Continuant to either the surface of the Earth or the Earth's mean Sea Level.

label: Amount
definition: A Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the total, aggregate or sum of a number of discrete items or material the entity contains as parts.

label: Bent
definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of the bearer having one or more angles along its border.

label: Black
definition: A Color that lacks any hues as parts.

label: Blond
definition: A Color that ranges from nearly white to a light greyish yellow.

label: Blue
definition: A Color that is between Cyan and Violet with a wavelength in the visible spectrum typically between 450 to 490 nanometers.

label: Blunt
definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of the bearer not having a sharp edge or point.

label: Body Shape
definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a Person's body by virtue of the body's general outline or figure.

label: Branched
definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of the bearer having subdivisions or offshoots.

label: Brown
definition: A Color that consists of dark orange and red, and of very low intensity.

label: Circumference
definition: A Perimeter that inheres in a circle or ellipse.

label: Closure
definition: A Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the degree to which that bearer affords passage or sightline through it via an opening, aperture, orifice, or vent.

label: Coiled
definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of the bearer being wound in concentric rings or spirals.

label: Color
definition: An Optical Property that inheres in a bearer in virtue of that bearer's Color Hue, Color Saturation and Color Brightness.

label: Color Brightness
definition: An Optical Property that inheres in a bearer in virtue of its capacity to reflect or radiate light.

label: Color Hue
definition: An Optical Property that inheres in a bearer in virtue of its capacity to reflect a dominant wavelength of the visible light spectrum, which is typically divided up into 6 to 8 ranges.

label: Color Saturation
definition: An Optical Property that inheres in a bearer in virtue of its capacity to reflect high intensity light distributed across fewer wavelengths, typically considered on a continuum of purity.

label: Concave Shape
definition: A Shape Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the bearer having one or more cavities, such that at least one line connecting a pair of points on the surface of the bearer will lie outside.

label: Cone Shape
definition: A Three Dimensional Shape that inheres in a bearer in virtue of it having a Round base that tapers smoothly to an apex.

label: Convex Shape
definition: A Shape Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the bearer not having a cavity, such that no line connecting a pair of points on the surface of the bearer will lie outside.

label: Cube Shape
definition: A Cuboidal shape inhering in a bearer in virtue of it having six Square faces.

label: Cuboidal
definition: A Three Dimensional Shape that inheres in a bearer in virtue of it having six Rectangular faces.

label: Curved
definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of the bearer having borders which are smoothly rounded.

label: Cyan
definition: A Color that is between Green and Blue with a wavelength in the visible spectrum typically between 490 and 520 nanometers.

label: Cylindrical
definition: A Three Dimensional Shape inhering in a bearer in virtue of the bearer having an elongated shape with round bases.

label: Depth
definition: A One Dimensional Extent that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the bearer's extension in a downward, backward, or inward direction.

label: Diameter
definition: A One Dimensional Extent that inheres in a circle in virtue of the extent of a straight line that passes through the center of the circle and starts and ends on the circle's boundary.

label: Disposition to Interact with Electromagnetic Radiation
definition: A Disposition that inheres in a bearer in virtue of how that bearer interacts with electromagnetic radiation.

label: Disrupting Disposition
definition: A disposition the realization of which would disrupt a process some entity has an interest in.

label: Drooping
definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of the bearer having a border that hangs downwards.

label: Fatigability
definition: A Realizable Entity that is realized when its bearer loses strength and tires quickly.

label: Flat
definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of the bearer having a horizontal border without a significant deviation.

label: Fluorescence
definition: A Luminescent Property that inheres in a bearer in virtue of that bearer's capacity to emit visible light while absorbing shorter wavelength radiation, but not after.

label: Folded
definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of one part of the bearer being layered over another connected part.

label: Gold Color
definition: A Color that resembles a yellow-orange Hue with the added feature of having a metallic shine.

label: Green
definition: A Color that is between Yellow and Cyan with a wavelength in the visible spectrum, typically between 520 to 560 nanometers.

label: Grey
definition: A Color between white and black colors.

label: Hardness
definition: A Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the degree to which it can be turned, bowed, or twisted without breaking.

label: Hazel
definition: A Color that is a combination of Brown and Green, typically associated with eye color.

label: Height
definition: A One Dimensional Extent that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the bearer's extension in a vertical direction.

label: Length
definition: A One Dimensional Extent that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the bearer's greatest extent in one direction.

label: Luminescent Property
definition: An Optical Property that inheres in a bearer in virtue of that bearer's capacity to emit visible light, but which isn't the result of the bearer being heated.

label: Magenta
definition: A Color consisting of red and blue hues.

label: Magnetism
definition: A Disposition that is realized when its bearer exerts a magnetic force on another entity.

label: Maroon
definition: A Color consisting of purple and brown hue.

label: Mass
definition: A Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the amount of matter in that bearer.

label: Mass Density
definition: A Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of that bearer's mass per unit volume.

label: Oblong
definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of the bearer having an long thin shape with approximately parallel sides.

label: One Dimensional Extent
definition: A Size Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the bearer's extension in one dimension.

label: Opacity
definition: A Disposition to Interact with Electromagnetic Radiation that inheres in a bearer in virtue of that bearer's capacity to transmit electromagnetic radiation of a given frequency through the bearer instead of reflecting, scattering, or absorbing electromangentic radiation of that frequency.

label: Opaque
definition: An Opacity that inheres in a bearer in virtue of that bearer's incapacity to transmit electromagnetic radiation of a given frequency through the bearer such that the bearer reflects, scatters, or absorbs all electromagnetic radiation of that frequency.

label: Optical Property
definition: A Disposition to Interact with Electromagnetic Radiation that is realized when its bearer interacts with electromagnetic waves within the visible light spectrum.

label: Orange
definition: A Color that is between Red and Yellow with a wavelength in the visible spectrum typically between 590 to 635 nanometers.

label: Perimeter
definition: A One Dimensional Extent that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the extent of a boundary which encloses the bearer.

label: Phase Angle
definition: A Relational Quality that is the angle between the light incident onto an observed Object and the light reflected from the Object.

label: Phosphorescence
definition: A Luminescent Property that inheres in a bearer in virtue of that bearer's capacity to emit visible light after absorbing shorter wavelength radiation, and to continue emitting after the absorbing process has ceased.

label: Pitch Orientation
definition: A Spatial Orientation of an Object relative to its Pitch Axis.

label: Pointing Orientation
definition: A Spatial Orientation of a Material Entity in which one or more of its designated components are oriented toward a specified direction.

label: Protruding
definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a part of an object in virtue of the part extending out above or beyond the surface of the object.

label: Purple
definition: A Color that is aproximately midway between Red and Blue.

label: Pyramidal
definition: A Three Dimensional Shape that inheres in a bearer in virtue of it having a polygonal base with vertices that all connect to the same apex to form triangular faces.

label: Radiation Absorptivity
definition: A Disposition to Interact with Electromagnetic Radiation that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the capacity of that bearer to absorb electromagnetic radiation of a given frequency.

label: Radiation Emissivity
definition: A Disposition to Interact with Electromagnetic Radiation that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the capacity of that bearer to emit electromagnetic radiation of a given frequency.

label: Radiation Reflectivity
definition: A Disposition to Interact with Electromagnetic Radiation that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the capacity of that bearer to scatter or reflect electromagnetic radiation of a given frequency.

label: Radioactive
definition: A Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of that bearer exhibiting or being caused by radioactivity.

label: Radiolucent
definition: A Radiopacity that inheres in a bearer in virtue of its capacity to permit most X-rays to pass through it.

label: Radiopacity
definition: An Opacity that inheres in a bearer in virtue of its capacity to allow or prevent X-rays to pass through it.

label: Radiopaque
definition: A Radiopacity that inheres in a bearer in virtue of its capacity to prevent most X-rays from passing through it.

label: Rectangular
definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of having four sides and four 90 degree angles.

label: Red
definition: A Color that is above Orange with a wavelength in the visible spectrum typically between 635 to 700 nanometers.

label: Refractivity
definition: A Radiation Reflectivity that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the capacity of that bearer to change the direction of a propagating wave when passing through it.

label: Roll Orientation
definition: A Spatial Orientation of an Object relative to its Roll Axis.

label: Rosy
definition: A Color consisting of red hue and yellow hue and high brightness.

label: Round
definition: A Shape Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of every point along its circumference being equidistant from the center.

label: Semicircular
definition: A Shape quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of the bearer having the shape of half a circle.

label: Serrated
definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of the bearer having multiple sharp points along a edge.

label: Shape Quality
definition: A Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the ratios between dimensions of external features of that bearer.

label: Sharp
definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of the bearer having a fine point or thin edge.

label: Silver Color
definition: A Color that resembles Grey with the added feature of having a metallic shine.

label: Size Quality
definition: A Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the bearer's extension in one or more dimensions.

label: Sloped
definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of the bearer having a horizontal border which is not level.

label: Spatial Orientation
definition: A Relational Quality that is the angle of Rotation of an Object relative to one or more Plane of Reference or Axis of Rotation.

label: Spherical
definition: A Three Dimensional Shape inhering in a bearer in virtue of all of its cross sections being round.

label: Split
definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of the bearer having a linear opening, or having been divided into parts.

label: Square
definition: A Rectangular shape which has four equal length sides and four 90 degree angles.

label: Straight
definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of the bearer not having curves, bends, or angles along its borders.

label: Strength
definition: A Realizable Entity that is realized when its bearer exerts or resists some power, influence, or force.

label: Surface Tension
definition: A Disposition that inheres in a liquid and is realized when the cohesive forces of the molecules in the bearer at the surface are greater than the adhesive forces of the molecules in the surrounding air.

label: Temperature
definition: A Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of its thermal energy.

label: Texture
definition: A Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the size, shape, and distribution of features on its surface, typically on a continuum from smooth to rough.

label: Thickness
definition: A Depth that inheres in a bearer in virtue of it extending inward through an object.

label: Thin
definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of the bearer having a width or depth which is significantly smaller in proportion to its length or height.

label: Three Dimensional Extent
definition: A Size Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the bearer's extension in three dimensions.

label: Three Dimensional Shape
definition: A Shape Quality that inheres only in a three dimensional entity.

label: Translucent
definition: An Opacity that inheres in a bearer in virtue of that bearer's capacity to transmit some but not all electromagnetic radiation of a given frequency through the bearer such that the bearer reflects, scatters, or absorbs some but not all electromagnetic radiation of that frequency.

label: Transparent
definition: An Opacity that inheres in a bearer in virtue of that bearer's capacity to transmit all or nearly all electromagnetic radiation of a given frequency through the bearer such that the bearer reflects, scatters, or absorbs little or no electromagnetic radiation of that frequency.

label: Triangular
definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of it having exactly three angles and exactly three sides.

label: Two Dimensional Extent
definition: A Size Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the bearer's extension in two dimensions.

label: Vermilion
definition: A Color consisting of red and orange hue with a slight amount of gray.

label: Violet
definition: A Color that is lower than Blue with a wavelength in the visible spectrum typically between 400 and 450 nanometers.

label: Vulnerability
definition: A Disrupting Disposition the realization of which would disrupt a process that the bearer of the Disrupting Disposition has an interest in.

label: Wavy
definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of it having a sinuous or rippled border.

label: Weight
definition: A Quality that inheres in some material entity with a mass in virtue of its location in some gravitational field.

label: Wetness
definition: A Quality that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the degree to which the bearer is covered by a liquid, typically on a continuum of dry to wet.

label: White
definition: A Color of maximum brightness, the color of objects that reflect nearly all wavelengths of the visible light spectrum, thus considered achromatic.

label: Wide
definition: A Shape Quality inhering in a bearer in virtue of the bearer having a width or depth which is significantly larger in proportion to its length or height.

label: Width
definition: A One Dimensional Extent that inheres in a bearer in virtue of the bearer's extension in a horizontal direction.

label: Yaw Orientation
definition: A Spatial Orientation of an Object relative to its Yaw Axis.

label: Yellow
definition: A Color that is between Orange and Green with a wavelength in the visible spectrum typically between 560 to 590 nanometers.
